recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中淋巴球明顯增多，許多細胞具有淡藍、邊緣有角的細胞質；高倍下淋巴球細胞質內可見成束、平行的細絲狀條紋（filamentous-like inclusions），核染色質呈塊狀，符合伴特殊細胞質包涵體的慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）。
features: Panel A: absolute lymphocytosis with many small to medium lymphocytes and a few neutrophils
Lymphocytes with moderate pale blue cytoplasm and angular or irregular cytoplasmic borders
Panel B: lymphocyte with parallel fine filamentous/fibrillar striations in the cytoplasm
Mature nucleus with clumped chromatin and no conspicuous nucleolus
Normocytic red cells with rouleaux-free distribution; smudge cells not prominent in these fields
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa; low and high power) shows an absolute lymphocytosis of small to medium mature-appearing lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and moderate, pale, angular cytoplasm. At high power, the cytoplasm contains parallel, fine filamentous striations. Prolymphocytes and blasts are not prominent in these fields. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with unusual filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions, a rare morphologic variant that should be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim surface light chain restriction).

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with a CD11c/CD25/CD103/annexin A1 phenotype, rather than intracytoplasmic parallel filaments.
Villous lymphocytes show short polar cytoplasmic projections and are CD5-negative/CD23-negative on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma / plasma cell with crystalline inclusions
ddx.vs: Crystal-containing cells show plasmacytoid features with rod-shaped immunoglobulin crystals and an IgM paraprotein, often with MYD88 L265P.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm indenting red cells and lack a clonal CD5+/CD23+ population.
